description_en: Queries the review details of an SMS template after you submit the template for review. You can view the template review status
description_zh: 申请模板后，通过此接口查询模板审核详情，可查看模板审核状态
name: GetSmsTemplate

parameters.help_en:
The SMS template code.

Obtain the SMS template code from the response parameters of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2807431.html operation.
View the SMS template code on the Template Management (https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/domestic/text/template) page
parameters.help_zh:
短信模板Code。

在https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2807431.html接口的返回参数中获取短信模板Code。
在模板管理 (https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/domestic/text/template)页面查看短信模板Code
parameters.name: template_code

RejectInfo.description_en: The reason for the review rejection
RejectInfo.example: 模板内容中包含错别字。

Code.description_en:
The request status code. Valid values:

OK: The request was successful.
For other error codes, see [API error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/101346.html）
Code.description_zh:
请求状态码。取值：

OK：代表请求成功。
其他错误码，请参见[API错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/101346.html）

CreateDate.description_en: The time when the SMS template was created

IntlType.description_en:
The international/Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan template type. When the TemplateType parameter returns 3, valid values:
0: SMS notification.
1: promotional SMS.
2: verification code
IntlType.description_zh:
国际/港澳台模板类型。当TemplateType参数返回值为3时，此参数取值：
0：短信通知。
1：推广短信。
2：验证码

Message.description_en: The description of the status code

OrderId.description_en:
The ticket ID.

Reviewers use this parameter when querying reviews. Provide this ticket ID when you need to expedite the review
OrderId.description_zh:
工单号。

审核人员查询审核时会用到此参数。您需要审核加急时需要提供此工单号

RelatedSignName.description_en: The SMS signature associated with the template when the template was submitted
RelatedSignName.description_zh: 申请模板时，关联的短信签名

Remark.description_en: The remarks for the SMS template application, which serve as reference information for template review
Remark.description_zh: 短信模板申请说明，是模板审核的参考信息之一

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. It is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

TemplateContent.description_en: The content of the SMS template
TemplateContent.example: 您正在申请手机注册，验证码为：${code}，5分钟内有效！

TemplateName.description_en: The name of the SMS template

TemplateStatus.description_en:
The template review status. Valid values:

0: under review.
1: approved.
2: rejected. The reason for the rejection is returned. Refer to Suggestions for handling SMS review failures (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/sms/user-guide/causes-of-application-failures-and-suggestions), and call the UpdateSmsTemplate (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/sms/developer-reference/api-dysmsapi-2017-05-25-updatesmstemplate) operation or modify the SMS template on the Template Management (https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/domestic/text/template) page.
10: review canceled
TemplateStatus.description_zh:
模板审核状态。返回值：

0：审核中。
1：通过审核。
2：未通过审核，会返回审核失败的原因，请参考短信审核失败的处理建议 (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/sms/user-guide/causes-of-application-failures-and-suggestions?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.41fd339f3bPSCQ)，调用UpdateSmsTemplate (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/sms/developer-reference/api-dysmsapi-2017-05-25-updatesmstemplate?spm)接口或在模板管理 (https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/domestic/text/template)页面修改短信模板。
10：取消审核

TemplateTag.description_en:
The template tag. Valid values:

2: user-created template.

3: system-provided template.

4: test template
TemplateTag.description_zh:
模板标识。取值：

2：用户自定义创建模板。

3：系统赠送模板。

4：测试模板

TemplateType.description_en:
The SMS type. Valid values:

0: authenticate.
1: SMS notification.
2: promotional SMS.
3: international/Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan message.

Only users that have completed verify your identity - Enterprise account can apply for promotional SMS and international/Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan messages. For details about the differences between individual and enterprise user privileges, see Usage notes (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/sms/user-guide/usage-notes)
TemplateType.description_zh:
短信类型。取值：

0：验证码。
1：短信通知。
2：推广短信。
3：国际/港澳台消息。

仅支持企业认证用户申请推广短信和国际/港澳台消息。个人用户与企业用户权益区别详情请参见使用须知 (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/sms/user-guide/usage-notes?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.67447f576NJnE8)

VariableAttribute.description_en:
The template variable rules.

For details about template variable rules, see Example documentation (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/sms/templaterule-template-variable-parameter-filling-example)
VariableAttribute.description_zh:
模板变量规则。

模板变量规则详情，请参见示例文档 (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/sms/templaterule-template-variable-parameter-filling-example)

VendorAuditStatus.description_en:
The review status of each carrier. This parameter is returned only for digital SMS templates.

The key represents the carrier. Valid values:

MOBILE_VENDOR: China Mobile.

TELECOM_VENDOR: China Telecom.

UNICOM_VENDOR: China Unicom.

The value represents the review status. Valid values:

0: under review.

1: approved.

2: rejected.

15: expired
VendorAuditStatus.description_zh:
各运营商审核状态，仅数字短信会返回该参数。


key代表运营商。取值：

MOBILE_VENDOR：中国移动。

TELECOM_VENDOR：中国电信。

UNICOM_VENDOR：中国联通。

 value代表审核状态。取值： 

0：审核中。

1：通过。

2：不通过。

15：已失效
VendorAuditStatus.title_en: 各运营商审核状态 key: MOBILE_VENDOR, TELECOM_VENDOR, UNICOM_VENDOR value: 运营商审核状态 0: 审核中 1:通过 2:不通过 15: 已失效
VendorAuditStatus.title_zh: 各运营商审核状态 key: MOBILE_VENDOR, TELECOM_VENDOR, UNICOM_VENDOR value: 运营商审核状态 0: 审核中 1:通过 2:不通过 15: 已失效
